verdicts.reason: Both break the same way: the yellow ribbon tails float at the 'During' line, cut off from the 'a Workout?' bar that has dropped well below them, the title stack sits over the busy handlebar and blurry background, and it ends up in the middle of the canvas with a lot of dead space underneath. A is worse because its top dashed rule runs almost the full width, across the hand and bottle, while B's shorter rule only clips the fingertip.
